titel: Steak turns grey instead of brown
kurz: The meat stews in its own juice instead of frying. The surface never gets hot enough for a crust.
bild_im_kopf: Like an overfilled fryer basket: the oil cools down and the chips turn limp instead of crisp. The pan only has as much heat as it has stored.

ursachen.warum: Without a sizzle, the water evaporates too slowly. The surface never reaches the 140 °C at which browning starts.
fix: Test: a drop of water dances as a little ball
Only then add oil and meat

ursachen.warum: Each piece draws heat from the pan. It cools so much that the juice that runs out stays put and the meat stews in it.
fix: Keep finished pieces warm in the oven at 80 °C

ursachen.warum: Water on the surface has to evaporate first. As long as it is there, the surface stays stuck at 100 °C.
fix: Ideal: leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry

ursachen.warum: At the start the crust needs undisturbed contact. Push and turn before it releases and you tear it off and cool the pan.
fix: Leave it until it releases by itself

ursachen.titel: The pan stores too little heat
ursachen.warum: A thin base cools down a lot when the meat goes in and heats back up only slowly.
fix: Use cast iron or a thick steel base

q1.frage: Did it sizzle loudly when the meat went into the pan?

q2.frage: Was there liquid in the pan after a minute?

q4.frage: Did you turn the meat early or push it around?
